objective: Route candidate-bound alpha diagnostics to every sleeve according to its declared quantitative evidence requirements without creating trading or promotion authority.

selection_bias_control.collection_priority: independent experiments, frozen hypotheses, and repeated out-of-sample observations

independent_samples.collection_priority: candidate-bound post-cost returns separated by sleeve, regime, and non-overlapping decision window

uncertainty_calibration.collection_priority: time-ordered forecast and realized-outcome pairs with stable labels and environment identifiers

signal_decay_fit.collection_priority: forecast ranks and realized outcomes across horizons with enough time depth for drift detection

payoff_asymmetry.collection_priority: post-cost outcomes partitioned by setup, side, holding horizon, and independently observed regime

capacity_headroom.collection_priority: spread, fee, slippage, volume, volatility, fill, and markout evidence at realistic paper notionals

crowding_residual.collection_priority: factor-aligned and residual sleeve returns with synchronized timestamps and crowding proxies

tail_survival.collection_priority: independent volatile, gap, liquidity-stress, and adverse-cost observations

regime_stability.collection_priority: point-in-time regime labels, transition observations, and post-cost outcomes across multiple states
